mn21:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn21:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Moliyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ ativelaṃ saṃsaṭṭho viharati.
mn21:2.2: Evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho āyasmā Moliyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharati:
mn21:2.3: sace koci bhikkhu āyasmato Moliyaphaggunassa sammukhā tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ten' āyasmā Moliyaphagguno kupito anattamano adhikaraṇam-pi karoti,
mn21:2.4: sace pana koci bhikkhu tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ sammukhā āyasmato Moliyaphaggunassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati tena tā bhikkhuniyo kupitā anattamanā adhikaraṇam-pi karonti.
mn21:2.5: Evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho āyasmā Moliyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharati.
mn21:3.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn21:3.2: Āyasmā bhante Moliyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ ativelaṃ saṃsaṭṭho viharati;
mn21:3.3: evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho bhante āyasmā Moliyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharati:
mn21:3.6: evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho bhante āyasmā Moliyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharatīti.
mn21:4.1: Atha kho Bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
mn21:4.2: Ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu mama vacanena Moliyaphaggunaṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi: \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn21:4.4: Evambhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato paṭissutvā yan' āyasmā Moliyaphagguno ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Moliyaphaggunaṃ etad-avoca:
mn21:4.6: Evam-āvuso ti kho āyasmā Moliyaphagguno tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Moliyaphaggunaṃ Bhagavā etad-avoca:
mn21:5.1: Saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Phagguna bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ ativelaṃ saṃsaṭṭho viharasi;
mn21:5.2: evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kira tvaṃ Phagguna bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharasi:
mn21:5.3: sace koci bhikkhu tuyhaṃ sammukhā tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati tena tvaṃ kupito anattamano adhikaraṇam-pi karosi,
mn21:5.4: sace pana koci bhikkhu tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ sammukhā tuyhaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati tena tā bhikkhuniyo kupitā anattamanā adhikaraṇam-pi karonti;
mn21:5.5: evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kira tvaṃ Phagguna bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharasīti. --
mn21:5.7: Nanu tvaṃ Phagguna kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito ti. --
mn21:6.1: Na kho te etaṃ Phagguna patirūpaṃ kulaputtassa saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitassa yan-tvaṃ bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ ativelaṃ saṃsaṭṭho vihareyyāsi.
mn21:6.2: Tasmātiha Phagguna tava ce pi koci sammukhā tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya tatrāpi tvaṃ Phagguna ye gahasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi;
mn21:6.4: Na c' eva me cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāmi hitānukampī ca viharissāmi mettacitto na dosantaro ti, evaṃ
mn21:6.6: Tasmātiha Phagguna tava ce pi koci sammukhā tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ pāṇinā pahāraṃ dadeyya leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dadeyya daṇḍena pahāraṃ dadeyya satthena pahāraṃ dadeyya, tatrāpi tvaṃ . . .
mn21:6.10: Tasmātiha Phagguna tava ce pi koci sammukhā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya tatrāpi tvaṃ . . .
mn21:6.13: Tasmātiha Phagguna tava ce pi koci pāṇinā pahāraṃ dadeyya leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dadeyya daṇḍena pahāraṃ dadeyya satthena pahāraṃ dadeyya, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ tatrāpi tvaṃ Phagguna ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi;
mn21:6.14: tatrāpi te Phagguna evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ: Na c' eva me cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāmi hitānukampī ca viharissāmi mettacitto na dosantaro ti, evaṃ
mn21:7.2: Ārādhayiṃsu vata me bhikkhave bhikkhū ekaṃ samayaṃ cittaṃ.
mn21:7.5: ekāsanabhojanaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave bhuñjamāno appābādhatañ-ca sañjānāmi appātaṅkatañ-ca lahuṭṭhānañ-ca balañ-ca phāsuvihārañ-ca.
mn21:7.6: Etha tumhe pi bhikkhave ekāsanabhojanaṃ bhuñjatha;
mn21:7.7: ekāsanabhojanaṃ kho bhikkhave tumhe pi bhuñjamānā appābādhatañ-ca sañjānissatha appātaṅkatañ-ca lahuṭṭhānañ-ca balañ-ca phāsuvihārañ-cāti.
mn21:7.8: Na me bhikkhave tesu bhikkhūsu anusāsanī karaṇīyā ahosi;
mn21:7.9: satuppādakaraṇīyam-eva me bhikkhave tesu bhikkhūsu ahosi.
mn21:7.10: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave subhūmiyaṃ cātummahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa ṭhito odhastapatodo,
mn21:7.11: tam-enaṃ dakkho yoggācariyo assadammasārathi abhirūhitvā vāmena hatthena rasmiyo gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena patodaṃ gahetvā yenicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ sāreyya pi paccāsāreyya pi,
mn21:7.12: evam-eva kho bhikkhave na me tesu bhikkhūsu anusāsanī karaṇīyā ahosi,
mn21:7.13: satuppādakaraṇīyam-eva me bhikkhave tesu bhikkhūsu ahosi.
mn21:7.14: Tasmātiha bhikkhave tumhe akusalaṃ pajahatha kusalesu dhammesu āyogaṃ karotha,
mn21:7.15: evaṃ hi tumhe pi imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatha.
mn21:8.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahantaṃ sālavanaṃ,
mn21:8.3: tassa kocid-eva puriso uppajjeyya atthakāmo hitakāmo yogakkhemakāmo,
mn21:8.4: so yā tā sālalaṭṭhiyo kuṭilā ojāpaharaṇiyo tā tacchetvā bahiddhā nīhareyya antovanaṃ suvisodhitaṃ visodheyya,
mn21:8.5: yā pana tā sālalaṭṭhiyo ujukā sujātā tā sammā parihareyya,
mn21:8.6: evaṃ h' etaṃ bhikkhave sālavanaṃ aparena samayena vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya;
mn21:8.7: evam-eva kho bhikkhave tumhe akusalaṃ pajahatha kusalesu dhammesu āyogaṃ karotha,
mn21:8.8: evaṃ hi tumhe pi imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatha. \ [...
mn21:9.1: content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave imissā yeva Sāvatthiyā Vedehikā nāma gahapatānī ahosi.
mn21:9.2: Vedehikāya bhikkhave gahapatāniyā evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn21:9.3: soratā Vedehikā gahapatānī, nivātā Vedehikā gahapatānī, upasantā Vedehikā gahapatānī ti.
mn21:9.4: Vedehikāya kho pana bhikkhave gahapatāniyā Kāḷī nāma dāsī ahosi, dakkhā analasā susaṃvihitakammantā.
mn21:9.5: Atha kho bhikkhave Kāḷiyā dāsiyā etadahosi:
mn21:9.6: Mayhaṃ kho ayyāya evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn21:9.7: soratā Vedehikā gahapatāni, nivātā Vedehikā gahapatānī, upasantā Vedehikā gahapatānī ti;
mn21:9.8: kin-nu kho me ayyā santaṃ yeva nu kho ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti udāhu asantaṃ,
mn21:9.9: udāhu mayh' ev' ete kammantā susaṃvihitā yena me ayyā santaṃ yeva ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti na asantaṃ;
mn21:9.11: Atha kho bhikkhave Kāḷī dāsī divā uṭṭhāsi.
mn21:9.12: Atha kho bhikkhave Vedehikā gahapatānī Kāḷiṃ dāsiṃ etad-avoca:
mn21:9.17: No vata re kiñci pāpi dāsi, divā uṭṭhāsīti kupitā anattamanā bhūkuṭiṃ akāsi.
mn21:9.18: Atha kho bhikkhave Kāḷiyā dāsiyā etad-ahosi:
mn21:9.19: Santaṃ yeva kho me ayyā ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti no asantaṃ,
mn21:9.20: mayh' ev' ete kammantā susaṃvihitā yena me ayyā santaṃ yeva ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti no asantaṃ;
mn21:9.22: Atha kho bhikkhave Kāḷī dāsī divātaraṃ uṭṭhāsi.
mn21:9.23: Atha kho bhikkhave Vedehikā gahapatānī Kāḷiṃ dāsiṃ etadavoca:
mn21:9.28: No vata re kiñci pāpi dāsi, divā uṭṭhāsīti kupitā anattamanā anattamanavācaṃ nicchāresi.
mn21:9.29: Atha kho bhikkhave Kāḷiyā dāsiyā etad-ahosi:
mn21:9.30: Santaṃ yeva kho me ayyā ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti no asantaṃ,
mn21:9.31: mayh' ev' ete kammantā susaṃvihitā yena me ayyā santaṃ yeva ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti no asantaṃ;
mn21:9.33: Atha kho bhikkhave Kāḷī dāsī divātaraṃ yeva uṭṭhāsi.
mn21:9.34: Atha kho bhikkhave Vedehikā gahapatānī Kāḷiṃ dāsiṃ etad-avoca: \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn21:9.39: No vata re kiñci pāpi dāsi, divā uṭṭhāsīti kupitā anattamanā aggaḷasūciṃ gahetvā sīse pahāraṃ adāsi, sīsaṃ vobhindi.
mn21:9.40: Atha kho bhikkhave Kāḷī dāsī bhinnena sīsena lohitena gaḷantena paṭivissakānaṃ ujjhāpesi:
mn21:9.42: passath' ayye nivātāya kammaṃ, passath' ayye upasantāya kammaṃ,
mn21:9.43: kathaṃ hi nāma ekadāsikāya: divā uṭṭhāsīti kupitā anattamanā aggaḷasūciṃ gahetvā sīse pahāraṃ dassati sīsaṃ vobhindissatīti.
mn21:9.44: Atha kho bhikkhave Vedehikāya gahapatāniyā aparena samayena evaṃ pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggañchi:
mn21:9.45: caṇḍī Vedehikā gahapatānī, anivātā Vedehikā gahapatānī, anupasantā Vedehikā gahapatānī ti.
mn21:10.1: Evam-eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhikkhu tāvad-eva soratasorato hoti nivātanivāto hoti upasantūpasanto hoti yāva na amanāpā vacanapathā phusanti;
mn21:10.2: yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ amanāpā vacanapathā phusanti atha kho bhikkhu sorato ti veditabbo nivāto ti veditabbo upasanto ti veditabbo.
mn21:10.3: Nāhan-taṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ suvaco ti vadāmi yo cīvara-piṇḍapāta-senāsana-gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārahetu suvaco hoti sovacassataṃ āpajjati,
mn21:10.5: taṃ hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu cīvara-piṇḍapāta-senāsana-gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ alabhamāno na suvaco hoti na sovacassataṃ āpajjati.
mn21:10.6: Yo ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ yeva sakkaronto dhammaṃ garukaronto dhammaṃ apacāyamāno suvaco hoti sovacassataṃ āpajjati tam-ahaṃ suvaco ti vadāmi.
mn21:10.7: Tasmātiha bhikkhave: Dhammaṃ yeva sakkaronto dhammaṃ garukaronto dhammaṃ apacāyamānā suvacā bhavissāma sovacassataṃ āpajjissāmāti
mn21:11.1: Pañc' ime bhikkhave vacanapathā yehi vo pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ:
mn21:11.7: Kālena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ akālena vā;
mn21:11.8: bhūtena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ abhūtena vā;
mn21:11.9: saṇhena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ pharusena vā;
mn21:11.10: atthasaṃhitena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ anatthasaṃhitena vā; \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn21:11.11: mettacittā vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ dosantarā vā.
mn21:11.13: Na c' eva no cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāma hitānukampī ca viharissāma mettacittā na dosantarā,
mn21:11.14: tañ-ca puggalaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā pharitvā viharissāma, tadārammaṇañ-ca sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharissāmāti.
mn21:12.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave puriso āgaccheyya kuddālapiṭakaṃ ādāya,
mn21:12.4: so tatra tatra khaṇeyya, tatra tatra vikireyya, tatra tatra oṭṭhubheyya, tatra tatra omutteyya:
mn21:12.7: Api nu so puriso imaṃ mahāpaṭhaviṃ apaṭhaviṃ kareyyāti. --
mn21:12.10: ayaṃ hi bhante mahāpaṭhavī gambhīrā appameyyā,
mn21:12.12: yāvad-eva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assāti. --
